dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, are you allergic to any medicine?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ər juː əˈlɜːrdʒɪk tə ˈɛni ˈmɛdəsən?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good. Here's your medicine. Take two pills three times a day.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. hɪrz jʊr ˈmɛdəsən. ˈteɪk ˈtuː ˈpɪlz ˈθriː taɪmz ə ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: After meals. And take them with water.
dialogue.reading: ˈæftər ˈmiːlz. ənd ˈteɪk ðɛm wɪð ˈwɔːtər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, don't drink coffee. And go to bed early.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ˈdoʊnt ˈdrɪŋk ˈkɔːfi. ənd ˈɡoʊ tə ˈbɛd ˈɜːrli.
